inputBoundary: One already-aggregated source-dataset row per app identity: appUseCount is the nonnegative integer count of source-defined app sessions (one foreground period), and distinctParticipantCount is the nonnegative integer count of distinct study participants represented among that app's uses.
outputBoundary: Retain an app only when both source predicates hold: appUseCount is strictly greater than 50 and distinctParticipantCount is at least 3. Because appUseCount is an integer, the existing lower-inclusive threshold gate represents >50 exactly as >=51.
limitations: This binding does not collect screenshots or reconstruct screen sessions and app sessions from Android events.
This binding does not choose an app-identity representation, attribute app sessions to participants, deduplicate source rows, or derive either aggregate count.
The caller must supply one source-dataset aggregate row per app identity; missing or non-integer counts fail closed rather than being interpreted as zero.
The separate exclusion of apps without a feed feature and the later exclusion of X are downstream and are not claimed.
Screenshot selection, LLM labeling, and quantitative regret analysis remain downstream.
